title: No clear incremental prediction of breathing irregularity from ECG respiratory-band spectral width in two public cohorts
abstract: ECG interbeat-interval respiratory-band spectral width showed no clear incremental prediction of log1p interbreath-interval CV beyond short-window HRV and PPG summaries: equal-record MSE gain 0.00003583 (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.00009468, 0.00017109) in BIDMC and 0.00001801 (-0.00030249, 0.00030905) in independent CapnoBase. Both intervals include zero; this is not equivalence or evidence of absence of respiratory information. Record-grouped cross-validation used 53 adult ICU recordings; frozen models were transported to42 adult/pediatric perioperative recordings. Registered checks did not establish improvement. These previously used datasets provide external transport, not untouched confirmation. No clinical outcome was tested.
